name: Milk Academy
verdict: A Turkish dairy producer based in Bursa, part of Cabir Holding since 2023.
note: Rating note: Milk Academy is the arm (sleeve) sponsor of Fenerbahce's men's basketball team from 2025/26. Founded 2006, producing at its Bursa plants; Turkish press reports it joined Cabir Holding in 2023. ON HOLD: proposed 'none' - the Cabir Holding parentage and its ownership need confirmation from a second, independent source before the rating can publish.
